semantic.justification: Original UInt32/UInt8 hex narrowing, UTF16 code-unit emission, RTF aliases and escaping, checked SAL conversion with ignored result and initially empty OString, signed Unicode controls, exact fallback widths/reset, and upr/ud grouping. Actual shared SAL byte ownership and converters are used. Hex stream output, picture and OLE utilities are not part of this text-string owner; no complete RTF/SAL ABI certification is asserted. B8TCAE adds an actual original allocator-pointer failure for UTF8 NUL conversion, checks propagated allocation assertion, restores the pointer and verifies normal emission resumes. The nullable finally-release path is genuinely covered and remains counted. R01 uses standing human authorization only for the separate post-conversion null guard: initialization supplies concrete empty storage; checked failure preserves it, successful conversion assigns non-null storage, and allocation failure throws before returning. The defensive guard remains. Exact token/remapped-counter proof excludes only one zero-hit throw and one alternative, preserving every other counter and4 functions. Seven public RTF utility tests reach strict100% (48 statements,28 alternatives,4 functions,41 lines). This documents a local defensive ownership invariant, not a suspected upstream defect or allocator/ABI parity.
